description: Lists the cap tables, exit waterfalls, fund models and unit economics, SaaS and ecommerce forecasts saved to the user's Hemrock account, plus fund models others have shared with them, newest first. Each has its kind, id, name, the user's role (owner, editor, viewer) and a url that opens it in the browser builder. Call this when the user mentions "my cap table", "my fund model", "my forecast" or a model by name, before building one from scratch. Free: uses no calculations. Needs a signed-in connection.

kind.description: "cap-table" (Cap Table builder), "waterfall" (Exit Waterfall builder), "fund" (the web Venture Capital Model), or "unit-economics", "saas-forecasting", "ecommerce-forecasting" (the web models with the same names as their compute tools).

name: list_saved_models
title: List saved models
